title: Auto Model
what: Picks the model and effort for every prompt, runs fast mode and Ultracode on auto, on or off per chat, and compacts first when a switch would re-read a long chat

parts.label: Pick the model for each prompt
Pick the effort for each prompt
Fast mode starts on auto in a new chat (turns on by itself for urgent asks); off starts it off
Ultracode starts on auto in a new chat (added to big multi-file code jobs; runs many helpers, uses more of your plan); off starts it off
Compact before a switch that would re-read a long chat
Auto Model chip above the prompt (only when Session Keeper's panel is hidden or off)
